text:
Mina Lopez: Quick sync 
Launching a split test on the pricing page tomorrow AM. Focus: simplify tier names, shrink FAQ, and test two estimator implementations (client-side quick calc vs server-side authoritative estimate).

Samir Gupta: Nice. Are we doing copy-only variants too or bundling with estimator?

Mina Lopez: We'll run 4 variants: 
A = concise tier names + compact FAQ (no estimator)
B = concise names + client estimator
C = concise names + server estimator (requires API hit)
D = control (current copy + full FAQ, no estimator)

Evelyn Park: For routing: Webinar CTA appears on B+C only. `contact_sales` button appears on all variants but we'll tag clicks with `pricing_variant` and `tier_selected`. High-intent `contact_sales` goes to AE queue; webinar signups to nurture. I'll add mapping in CRM.

Tom Rivers: Design link: https://redwood.design/figma/pricing-split-02 
Compact names suggested: `Starter`, `Pro`, `Scale` -> or `Starter`, `Pro`, `Enterprise`? Leaning `Starter/Pro/Enterprise` for clarity.

Samir Gupta: Prefer `Starter/Pro/Enterprise`. Also note server estimator will increase requests to the estimator API; ops needs a flag to throttle.

ops-bot: Reminder: create Optimizely experiment key `pricing_split_2026_03`. Create GTM events: `pricing_variant_view`, `estimator_client_run`, `estimator_server_run`, `contact_sales_click`, `webinar_signup`.

Mina Lopez: Evelyn, please confirm CRM mapping and webinar nurture flow by EOD. Samir, coordinate with infra for rate limit toggle. Tom, add microcopy variants (short and ultra-short) for each tier label.

Evelyn Park: CRM mapping done: https://redwood.docs/pricing/2026-03-crm-map.md 
Routing: webinar -> marketing_webinar_nurture, contact_sales -> AE_high_intent. Also adding `lead_quality` tag based on form answers.

Samir Gupta: Infra: will add `estimator_server` feature flag and a 5rps default limit per region. Note: for EU visitors we should avoid server hits until cookie consent; we'll gate by CMP.

legal-bot: Quick check: tier name `Enterprise` approved. No naming conflicts found. Reminder to keep SKU IDs internal.

Mina Lopez: Great. Analytics plan: 10-day run, primary metric = `contact_sales` CTR normalized by variant views; secondary = webinar signup rate, estimator usage rate, median time-on-page, and lead_quality distribution. We'll also look at conversion velocity (time from view->contact).

Tom Rivers: Uploaded microcopy: options A (15-20 chars), B (8-12 chars) for each tier. Also added a tooltip copy for "Why pick Dedicated" and a one-line FAQ summary (80-100 chars) for compact FAQ.

Samir Gupta: Production checklist: optly keys, GTM tags, server flag, CMP gating, /health endpoint monitoring for estimator API, and log `estimator_latency_ms`.

Mina Lopez: Can we also capture an `estimator_cost_estimate` event with a coarse bucket (`low`/`medium`/`high`) so finance can estimate hit cost?

Evelyn Park: Added `estimator_cost_bucket` to event schema.

ops-bot: QA checklist: copy proofed, links validated, accessibility aria-expanded present for accordions, events firing in staging.

Mina Lopez: Final: 15m go/no-go tomorrow 09:45 PT. Postmortem + screenshots + short launch blurb for the product blog after test completion. Thanks all. :party_popper:
